public.title: Schema Validator II
public.description: input {type,min?,max?,value}; type is integer or string. Reject type mismatches first. For integer validate inclusive min/max of the value; for string validate inclusive min/max of character length. Return an array of error labels in order: ["type"] on type mismatch, otherwise any failed "min" then "max" constraints. Missing constraints are skipped; min may exceed max so both can fail. This descriptor encodes chained validation rules. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Check type once, derive numeric magnitude or string length, then apply ordered inclusive rules. O(1) time and space for ASCII strings. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
